Blaze 10000mAh Power Bank – Jute Finished with Wireless Charging

The Blaze 10000mAh Power Bank Jute Finished With Wireless Charging is a perfect blend of performance, durability, and eco-conscious design. Engineered for modern professionals, travelers, and corporate gifting needs, this premium power bank delivers reliable charging with advanced features like 15W wireless charging, 22.5W fast charging, and a rugged yet elegant jute-finished exterior. Designed to meet everyday power demands, it ensures your devices stay charged wherever you go.

With a powerful 10000mAh capacity, the Blaze power bank is ideal for charging smartphones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices multiple times. The integrated suction cups provide enhanced grip and stability during wireless charging, preventing device slippage and ensuring efficient power transfer. This makes it an excellent choice for office desks, travel use, and on-the-go productivity.

The jute finished power bank stands out with its eco-friendly and premium look, making it a popular option for corporate gifts, employee joining kits, and promotional giveaways. The durable design not only enhances aesthetics but also offers long-lasting protection against everyday wear and tear. Businesses looking for sustainable and high-utility branding solutions will find this power bank an ideal fit.

  • Built-in Cables: Convenient integrated cables reduce the need for carrying extra accessories.
  • Suction Cups: Enhanced grip ensures stable wireless charging without slipping.
  • Jute Finished Exterior: Eco-friendly, premium, and stylish design suitable for gifting.
  • Durable Design: Built to withstand regular usage for long-term reliability.
